card.name: Acetylcysteine antidote for acetaminophen overdose
card.fires_on: Words just before or inside the name acetylcysteine (N-acetylcysteine, NAC) in acetaminophen overdose treatment text. Also linking words like with or of that lead into it.

modes.label: Inside acetylcysteine
modes.description: Partway through the spelling of acetylcysteine in antidote instructions.

modes.label: Linking word before the antidote
modes.description: A small word such as with or of that comes right before acetylcysteine or a similar treatment.
